content:
Returns a list of the top attack techniques in your organization that match the specified search
criteria. The response includes details about each technique, such as MITRE ATT&CK framework
information, mitigations, and metadata.
This endpoint supports advanced search capabilities, including filtering, sorting, and pagination.
For more information, see Top Attack Techniques in the Exposure Management User Guide.
Requires the Basic [16] user role or the ATTACK_PATH_ANALYSIS.QUERY.SEARCH  custom role
privilege. See Roles and Permissions.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
QUERY PARAMETERS
integer
[ 100 .. 10000 ]
Default: 1000
The number of attack technique records to retrieve. If omitted, the default
value is 1000 . The minimum value is 100  and the maximum value is
10000 .
integer
>= 0
Default: 0
The number of records to skip for offset-based pagination. If omitted, the
default value is 0 .
string ^[a-zA-Z_]+:(asc|ASC|ascending|ASCENDING|Asce...
Show pattern
Example: sort=priority:desc
limit
offset
sort
The property and direction to sort the results by, in the format
property:direction . For example: name:asc  or priority:desc .
Supported properties for sorting include last_updated_at , priority ,
mitre_id , name , technique_name , status , state , and
vector_ount .
REQUEST BODY SCHEMA:
application/json
optional
Filter conditions for searching attack techniques. Filter operators can include nested conditions and
operators to create complex filtering logic.
One of
Single Filter
Multiple Filters
string
Enum: "priority"
"state"
"status"
"name"
"procedureName"
"mitre_id"
"tactics"
"target"
"source"
"cause"
"last_updated_at"
"created"
"serial_id"
The property to filter on.
For example, you might filter by priority , name , or
last_updated_at .
string
Enum: "eq"
"ne"
"gt"
"gte"
"lt"
"lte"
"contains"
"not_contains"
"in"
"not_in"
The comparison operator to apply to the filter. For example: eq , ne , etc.
Single String Value (string) or Array of Multiple String Values (strings) or Single
Integer Value (integer) or Array of Multiple Integer Values (integers) or Single
Boolean Value (boolean)
The value to use for comparison in the filter.
